facts.fact: Lucia的父亲Salvatore形容枯槁、灰败（以年纪论不该溃败至此），把眼前的实体认作『Dorian』、喃喃『Dorian, no sugar』；实体失笑，仍倒咖啡并把biscotto放到碟边递给他
facts.quote: “Dorian,” Salvatore muttered, his voice scratched and aged, “no sugar.”

facts.fact: 因为当年的bargain，Salvatore不由自主地在两个世界间闪烁——一半时间（half）悬在中间——最终将彻底『过去』到女儿所称的Otherside
facts.quote: spending half his time in between, eventually to pass fully over to the Otherside

facts.fact: Salvatore问『你是来收账的吗（Are you here to collect?）』；他座椅底部刻着上次试图召唤实体时设下的困缚符印（trapping sigil），在实体耳中如水壶鸣响——人类称之为耳鸣
facts.quote: The trapping sigil carved in the bottom of the seat from when he’d last tried to summon me

facts.fact: 这个被打败的男人恳求实体：『别伤害她——求你了』
facts.quote: “Don’t hurt her”—the words of a defeated man—“please.”

facts.fact: 实体夸『她出落得真好——喜欢我的贡献吗』并在胸前画了个cross；Salvatore满脸涨红、大吼『Leave! Go!』，把咖啡杯朝实体砸去
facts.quote: He tossed the cup at me, the shatter disturbing the stillness of the room.

facts.fact: Salvatore哭喊『我必须跟Lucia谈谈！我的journal，我的journal！』，又恳求『Dorian』答应把journal交给她；Lucia没有咒骂、沉默地上楼离开
facts.quote: “Dorian, you have to give it to her. Please, my good man, promise me you will.”

facts.fact: Salvatore的妻子、Lucia的母亲Nina抚着他的头发，用『和她女儿一样直截了当』的眼神命实体去『Handle it』；实体立即退出房间上楼
facts.quote: His wife, Nina, looked at me, her stare much like her daughter’s—direct, concise.

facts.fact: 在Lucia儿时的房间里，实体倾身逼近（心想『Kiss me』），Lucia一巴掌甩在他脸侧、随即提着沉重的鞋离去，只留他一人
facts.quote: A sharp sting against the side of my face and a sound like the crack of a whip.
